text: There's nowhere to go right now.
Let whatever is under you hold your weight.
Notice the space just beyond your skin.
It's quiet here, and it's alive.
Connected to everything, separated from nothing.
Let that space open past the walls of the room.
Every good possibility is already here, waiting.
Feel what abundance feels like in your chest.
A warmth, an openness, a quiet overflow.
Let your hands rest open, ready to receive.
Something good is already moving toward you.
Let that warmth glow outward from your heart.
All of this is yours to keep.
